verdict.rationale: The only pricing-related evidence is a first-party doc line saying feature flags and 2 million metered events are free, which hints that metered events drive cost. There is no published price list, no paid-tier pricing, and no explanation of how seats, MAUs or requests affect cost. Missing for 10: published pricing page with paid tier prices, documentation of cost drivers beyond metered events (seats, MAUs, requests), overage rates, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can see published pricing and understand what drives cost (seats, MAUs, events, requests) before committing

citations.quote: You get feature flags and 2 million metered events for free.
